from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
import math, os
smiles='C[C@]12CC[C@H]3[C@H]([C@@H]1CCC2=O)CCC4=C3C=CC(=C4)O'
m0=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
assert m0 is not None
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m0, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('canonical:', Chem.MolToSmiles(m0, isomericSmiles=True))
print('formula:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m0))
print('chiral centers before:', Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m0, includeUnassigned=True, includeCIP=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
base=Chem.AddHs(m0)
print('atoms with H:', base.GetNumAtoms(), 'formula:', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(base))

best=None; bestE=float('inf'); bestseed=None
for seed in range(1,41):
    mol=Chem.Mol(base)
    params=AllChem.ETKDGv3()
    params.randomSeed=seed*7919
    params.maxAttempts=2000
    params.useRandomCoords=True
    params.enforceChirality=True
    params.trackFailures=True
    try:
        cid=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol, params)
    except Exception as e:
        continue
    if cid!=0:
        continue
    # optimize
    ok=False
    if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mol):
        try:
            res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, mmffVariant='MMFF94s', maxIters=5000)
            ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mol, AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mol, mmffVariant='MMFF94s'))
            E=ff.CalcEnergy()
            ok=True
        except Exception as e:
            ok=False
    if not ok:
        try:
            res=AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(mol, maxIters=5000)
            ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(mol)
            E=ff.CalcEnergy()
            ok=True
        except Exception as e:
            ok=False
    if not ok:
        continue
    if E < bestE:
        bestE=E; best=mol; bestseed=seed
print('best seed', bestseed, 'energy', bestE)
assert best is not None
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(best, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('chiral centers after:', Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(best, includeUnassigned=True, includeCIP=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
conf=best.GetConformer()
lines=[str(best.GetNumAtoms()), 'estrone 3-hydroxyestra-1,3,5(10)-trien-17-one; RDKit ETKDG/MMFF']
for i,a in enumerate(best.GetAtoms()):
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
    lines.append(f"{a.GetSymbol():<2} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}")
open('answer.xyz','w').write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
print('wrote answer.xyz', os.path.getsize('answer.xyz'))
print('\n'.join(lines[:5]))
print('... last', lines[-1])

python3 - <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdMolDescriptors
import os, math
# read xtb xyz
with open('answer_xtb.xyz') as f:
    lines=[l.rstrip('\n') for l in f]
n=int(lines[0].strip())
print('xtb n', n, 'comment', lines[1])
atoms=[]
for l in lines[2:2+n]:
    parts=l.split()
    atoms.append((parts[0], float(parts[1]), float(parts[2]), float(parts[3])))
print('elements', ''.join(a[0] for a in atoms), 'count', len(atoms))
# original smiles molecule with explicit H, ensure same element order
smiles='C[C@]12CC[C@H]3[C@H]([C@@H]1CCC2=O)CCC4=C3C=CC(=C4)O'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
elems=[a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms()]
print('match element order:', elems == [a[0] for a in atoms])
# set conformer to xtb coords
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(el,x,y,z) in enumerate(atoms):
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i, Point3D(x,y,z))
m.RemoveAllConformers()
m.AddConformer(conf, assignId=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('formula', rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print('chiral centers', Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m, includeUnassigned=True, includeCIP=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
# write final answer.xyz from xtb coords, with desired comment
out=[str(m.GetNumAtoms()), 'estrone 3-hydroxyestra-1,3,5(10)-trien-17-one; GFN2-xTB optimized']
for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
    out.append(f"{a.GetSymbol():<2} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}")
open('answer.xyz','w').write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
print('wrote final answer.xyz bytes', os.path.getsize('answer.xyz'))
# basic sanity: bond lengths for heavy atom bonds from mol
for b in m.GetBonds():
    i=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(); j=b.GetEndAtomIdx()
    if m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetAtomicNum()>1 and m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetAtomicNum()>1:
        pi=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); pj=conf.GetAtomPosition(j)
        d=math.dist((pi.x,pi.y,pi.z),(pj.x,pj.y,pj.z))
        if d<0.8 or d>1.9:
            print('unusual bond', i,j,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol(),m.GetAtomWithIdx(j).GetSymbol(),d)
print('done')
PY
